lines: Winter 2027 runs January to March in San Francisco. The on-time deadline was November 2. Late applications are open.
YC says to apply as soon as you are ready. It says about 40% of the companies it funds in each batch are just an idea, and most have no revenue.
YC regularly accepts solo founders, and says one-person startups are tough.
The deal is $500,000: $125,000 for 7%, plus $375,000 on an uncapped MFN SAFE.

answer.text: A planner that turns a trip idea into a booked itinerary.

boxes.question: Pick one customer
boxes.need: Confirm the draft; Used must be met
boxes.command: teyla startup yc confirm sample-app customer

answer.text: A freelance travel writer who plans four trips a year.

boxes.question: What does it do for them?
boxes.command: teyla startup yc answer sample-app does "<the job it does for that customer>"

boxes.question: Are they using it?
boxes.evidence: 24 outside people (assumed: accounts minus the owner), 7 active this week, 2 returned at day 7. As of 2026-11-04.

boxes.question: What do they pay?
boxes.evidence: $0. The product does not charge yet.

boxes.question: Why you?
boxes.command: teyla startup yc answer sample-app why_you "<why you are the one to build it>"

boxes.question: Is it custom software per customer?
boxes.command: teyla startup yc answer sample-app custom "<yes or no, and why>"

boxes.question: What is the Demo Day goal?
boxes.command: teyla startup yc answer sample-app goal "<one number or one outcome>"

boxes.question: Who does what?
boxes.command: teyla startup yc answer sample-app who "<include what the agents do>"

boxes.question: How many customers have you talked to?
boxes.need: One ICP conversation you logged yourself

boxes.question: How do you sell it?
boxes.need: An answer; Tried must be met
boxes.command: teyla startup yc answer sample-app sell "<the channel you use, as it is today>"

boxes.question: Show us the demo
boxes.command: teyla startup yc answer sample-app demo "<a link to the demo (https://...)>"

boxes.question: When did the first customer go live?
boxes.need: An answer; Used must be met
boxes.command: teyla startup yc answer sample-app first_live "<a date and who>"

boxes.question: What do they need most?
boxes.command: teyla startup yc answer sample-app need "<what customers asked for>"

boxes.question: Can you commit to the batch?
boxes.command: teyla startup yc answer sample-app commit "<it is in person in San Francisco>"
